note: Provenance for the curated real-lyrics corpus (issue #668). Every field here is READ by tests/test_lyrics_corpus_668.py — durationSec is what the overshoot measurement needs and the artifacts themselves do not carry it, and sha256 pins the bytes so a re-export cannot silently move a measured number. Renaming or dropping the media ids was considered and rejected: the raw archive is already committed with the ids intact on the branch above, so renaming here would not un-commit them and would only break the trace back to the source.

specimens.title: Total Eclipse of the Heart
specimens.pins: WRONG VERSION, labelled by construction: the text is timed to a 374s master against 268s of audio, so 25 of its 97 lines start after the song has ended. Ground truth for OVERSHOOT_FRACTION_MAX (#667) with no human judgement needed.

specimens.title: Friends in Low Places
specimens.pins: The SECOND wrong-version case, and the shallower of the two: +27% overshoot where Total Eclipse is +39%. One case cannot show a band; this is the near edge of it.

specimens.title: Since U Been Gone
specimens.pins: The NEGATIVE case: a correct same-recording pick, 48 lines ending at 185.0s inside 191s of audio, zero lines past the end. Without it an overshoot guard could pass vacuously by flagging everything.

specimens.title: WE ARE JAPANESE GOBLIN [MMD]
specimens.pins: A DEGENERATE real ASR baseline: 1594 words crammed into 12 lines, one phrase repeated tens of times, language detected as ja. It clears MIN_TOKENS_TO_COMPARE on distinct tokens and therefore VOTES rather than abstaining. The baseline half of the corpus's only same-audio pair.

specimens.title: WE ARE JAPANESE GOBLIN [MMD]
specimens.pins: The candidate half of the same pair, from the SAME upload: an authored English caption track over Japanese audio, i.e. a translation. Real (candidate, baseline) pairs are what a coverage threshold has to be calibrated on, and this is the only one the archive holds.

specimens.title: Skyfall
specimens.pins: Line 1 is a bare music-note glyph and nothing else. Real authoritative text whose first line tokenises to zero tokens, reaching the tokeniser, the aligner and the TV.

specimens.title: Mr. Brightside
specimens.pins: LINE-only real caption track: 32 timed lines, zero timed words. The floor case for sync, and the shape that must not be mistaken for a word-timed artifact.

specimens.title: Legends Never Die
specimens.pins: WORD-timed real caption track, the same tier as the line-only one above. The pair is what makes the line-only/word-level distinction measurable instead of asserted.
